name: Standing Quad Stretch
description: A standing hold that loosens the quads after leg-focused strength sessions.
instructions: Stand tall, holding onto a wall or chair for balance if needed.
Bend one knee and grab your ankle behind you, pulling your heel toward your glutes.
Keep your knees close together and hold, then switch sides.

name: Hip Flexor Lunge Stretch
description: A kneeling lunge stretch that opens tight hip flexors from squatting and deadlifting.
instructions: Step into a half-kneeling lunge with your back knee on the floor.
Tuck your pelvis under and shift your hips forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the back hip.
Hold, keeping your torso upright, then switch legs.

name: Chest Opener (Doorway Stretch)
description: Uses a doorway to counteract tight pecs from heavy pressing work.
instructions: Stand in a doorway and place your forearms on the frame at shoulder height.
Step one foot forward and gently lean through the doorway.
Hold the stretch across your chest and front shoulders.

name: Shoulder Cross-Body Stretch
description: A simple cross-body pull that relieves shoulder tightness after pressing or pulling days.
instructions: Bring one arm straight across your chest.
Use your other arm to gently pull it closer to your body.
Hold, keeping the shoulder relaxed away from your ear, then switch arms.

name: Seated Forward Fold
description: A seated fold that lengthens the hamstrings and lower back after deadlifts or squats.
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs extended straight in front of you.
Hinge at the hips and reach toward your toes, keeping your back long.
Hold at your comfortable end range without forcing the stretch.

name: Cat-Cow Spinal Stretch
description: A flowing spinal movement that restores mobility after loaded barbell work.
instructions: Start on hands and knees in a tabletop position.
Inhale, drop your belly and lift your chest and tailbone (cow).
Exhale, round your spine and tuck your chin and tailbone (cat). Repeat smoothly.

name: Lat Stretch (Overhead Side Reach)
description: An overhead side reach that opens the lats after pull-ups or rows.
instructions: Stand tall and raise one arm straight overhead.
Lean your torso to the opposite side, reaching over.
Hold the stretch along your side and lat, then switch.

name: Glute Figure-4 Stretch
description: A figure-4 hold that releases the glutes after squats and lunges.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee, forming a figure-4 shape.
Pull the uncrossed thigh toward your chest until you feel a stretch in the crossed hip, then switch.

name: Standing Toe Touch
description: A standing fold that lengthens the posterior chain after cardio sessions.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward from the hips and reach toward your toes, letting your knees soften.
Hold, relaxing your neck and shoulders.

name: Dynamic Leg Swings
description: Controlled front-to-back swings that raise heart rate and open the hips before cardio.
instructions: Hold onto a wall or chair for balance.
Swing one leg forward and backward in a controlled motion.
Keep your core engaged and repeat for the set number of swings, then switch legs.

name: Walking Lunge with Twist
description: A moving lunge with a torso twist that warms the legs and core together.
instructions: Step forward into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor.
Rotate your torso toward your front leg, reaching your arms with the twist.
Return to center, step through, and repeat on the other side.

name: Standing Side Bend
description: A lateral bend that mobilizes the sides of the torso between cardio intervals.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, one arm reaching overhead.
Bend your torso to the opposite side, keeping hips stacked.
Hold the stretch along your side, then switch.

name: Butterfly Stretch
description: A seated inner-thigh stretch that cools down the hips after high-rep leg work.
instructions: Sit with the soles of your feet together, knees falling out to the sides.
Hold your feet and gently press your knees toward the floor.
Sit tall and hold, breathing steadily.

name: Downward Dog Stretch
description: A full-body inverted-V stretch that lengthens the hamstrings, calves, and shoulders.
instructions: Start on hands and knees, then lift your hips up and back.
Straighten your legs as much as comfortable, pressing your heels toward the floor.
Keep your spine long and hold.

name: Calf Stretch Against Wall
description: A wall-assisted stretch that eases calf tightness after running or jump-based cardio.
instructions: Place both hands on a wall, one foot back with the heel flat on the floor.
Keep the back leg straight and lean forward slightly toward the wall.
Hold the stretch in the calf, then switch legs.

name: Seated Spinal Twist
description: A seated rotation that mobilizes the spine and obliques after cardio work.
instructions: Sit with legs extended, then cross one foot over the opposite knee.
Twist your torso toward the bent knee, using your arm for leverage.
Hold the twist, keeping your spine tall, then switch sides.

name: Neck Tilt Stretch
description: A gentle side tilt that releases everyday neck tension.
instructions: Sit or stand tall with shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head toward one shoulder, letting the opposite shoulder stay down.
Hold gently, then switch sides.

name: Shoulder Rolls
description: A light mobility drill to loosen the shoulders during a maintenance routine.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with arms relaxed at your sides.
Roll both shoulders up, back, and down in a smooth circle.
Repeat for the set number of rolls, then reverse direction.

name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
description: A simple standing stretch to keep the hamstrings supple.
instructions: Place one heel on a low step or the floor in front of you, leg straight.
Hinge forward from the hips, keeping your back flat.
Hold, then switch legs.

name: Torso Rotation Stretch
description: A standing rotation that keeps the core and spine mobile.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, arms relaxed or crossed over your chest.
Rotate your torso gently to one side, then the other.
Keep the movement controlled and repeat for the set number of reps.

name: Child's Pose
description: A resting pose that decompresses the lower back and calms the body.
instructions: Kneel on the floor and sit back onto your heels.
Fold forward, extending your arms in front of you and resting your forehead down.
Breathe deeply and hold.

name: Ankle Circles
description: A small joint-mobility drill that keeps the ankles healthy.
instructions: Sit or stand, lifting one foot slightly off the floor.
Rotate your ankle in slow circles in one direction, then reverse.
Repeat for the set number of circles, then switch feet.

name: Cobra Stretch
description: A gentle backbend that keeps the front of the body and spine supple.
instructions: Lie face down with hands under your shoulders.
Press through your hands to lift your chest, keeping hips on the floor.
Hold, then lower back down.

name: Cross-Leg Seated Twist
description: A seated twist that maintains everyday spinal rotation.
instructions: Sit cross-legged on the floor.
Place one hand behind you and the other on the opposite knee, then twist toward the back hand.
Hold, then switch directions.

name: Bicep Wall Stretch
description: A wall-assisted stretch that targets the biceps after pulling or curling work.
instructions: Stand next to a wall and place your palm flat against it, arm straight, fingers pointing back.
Slowly rotate your body away from the wall until you feel a stretch in the bicep.
Hold, then switch arms.

name: Tricep Overhead Stretch
description: An overhead reach that lengthens the triceps after pressing work.
instructions: Raise one arm overhead and bend the elbow, dropping your hand behind your head.
Use your other hand to gently press on the bent elbow.
Hold, then switch arms.

name: Pec Doorway Stretch
description: A doorway stretch that targets the chest after heavy pressing sessions.
instructions: Stand in a doorway with your forearm on the frame, elbow at shoulder height.
Step forward through the doorway until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Hold, then repeat facing the other arm forward.

name: Hamstring Floor Reach
description: A floor-based reach that lengthens the hamstrings after leg day.
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs extended straight ahead.
Reach forward along your legs toward your feet, keeping your back long.
Hold at your end range.

name: Quad Standing Pull Stretch
description: A standing pull that stretches the quads after squats or lunges.
instructions: Stand tall, holding a wall for balance if needed.
Bend one knee and pull your heel toward your glutes, keeping knees together.
Hold, then switch legs.

name: Piriformis Stretch (Seated Figure-4)
description: A seated figure-4 hold that releases the glutes after heavy lower-body training.
instructions: Sit tall in a chair and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hinge forward from the hips, keeping your back flat.
Hold the stretch in the hip, then switch sides.

name: Upper Back Stretch
description: A rounded reach that stretches the upper back after rowing or pulling work.
instructions: Clasp your hands together in front of you at shoulder height.
Round your upper back and push your hands away, tucking your chin slightly.
Hold, feeling the stretch between your shoulder blades.

name: Wrist Flexor/Extensor Stretch
description: A two-way wrist stretch that eases forearm tightness after heavy gripping work.
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you, palm up, and gently pull the fingers back with your other hand.
Hold, then flip the palm down and gently press the hand down for the extensor stretch.
Switch arms and repeat both directions.
